name: Doorway Chest Stretch
focus: Chest and front of the shoulders
description: Standing in a doorway with a forearm on each side of the frame, step one foot through and lean forward until you feel a stretch across the chest.

source.title: Hinge Health: Stretches to do after sitting all day

setup: Stand in a doorway, elbows bent and at about chest height, a forearm on each side of the frame.
cues: Gentle: no pinching at the front of the shoulder.

prescription.note: Ease in until you feel a gentle stretch; no bouncing.

keyframes.name: Forearms on the frame
keyframes.cue: Stand in a doorway, forearms on each side, elbows at chest height.

keyframes.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
keyframes.cue: Step one foot through and lean your chest forward.
